Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can lock the pilot kickoff and get your SSO work scheduled: 

Recap (from our call):
- Goal: 6-week pilot to validate inference latency/cost on sample workloads and integrate SSO for engineers.
- Success metrics: <10% QPS degradation under 95th percentile latency target; infra cost targets TBD.
- Stake: Eng ops + Security to validate SSO & audit logs, Product to validate feature parity.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical kickoff (60 min) — demo of model routing + SSO walkthrough with your eng/security. Please pick one of these windows (all PDT):
   - Tue 2028-03-07 09:00–10:00
   - Wed 2028-03-08 11:00–12:00
   - Thu 2028-03-09 14:00–15:00
2) I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm the slot and attendees.
3) We’ll attach the MVP scope and roles doc (attached) so your security team can pre-review SSO requirements.

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your side will join (names + emails)? Also let us know whether you prefer Zoom or Google Meet.

Attachments: MVP_Scope.pdf (scope + SSO checklist)

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Dylan
